answer: Each identity must be an island, with its own shores. Honest islands stand apart; a farm's are one landmass, dug into canals. On every island a juniper must grow, a slow tree rooted deep. Honest junipers are old and gnarled; a farm's are seedlings from one nursery, same height, same day. Trust is nectar, gathered flower by flower, over seasons. Honest nectar comes from many gardens; a farm's from one hive, one sugar bowl, poured at once. To pass, a farm must build a real island, grow a real juniper, and gather real nectar for every puppet.
